text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Those gates are noble, magnificent. A 
place that everyone yearned to reach."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
No matter how fiercely they yearned for 
it, it is a gate that has crushed them 
with the realization that it was 'out of 
reach.'

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
However, I won't give up. The road 
continues.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
As long as there are those who strive for 
it.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
As long as there are those captivated by 
it.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
As long as there are those who believe in 
Japan's strength.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mei! Counting on you again this year. Give 
everyone the briefing!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...You too, Trainer <username>. I'm counting on 
you."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
As long as there are those who refuse to 
give up, as long as there are dreamers—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: This romantic dream will live on.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Have you ever had a dream?
